environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with public internet access. ALB target group health check on /docs. Security group allows inbound TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Any user who can obtain a valid session token (e.g., by registering an account) can enumerate and access other users' profiles, documents, and PII by changing the user_id path parameter.
